content.title: The Official Tourism Site For Laguna Beach, California
content.text: The Oneand OnlyLaguna BeachPart art colony, part surf town, part canyon soul and ocean rhythm.Discover theTrue LagunaFrom the Green Belt to the Blue Belt, canyon studios to a bohemian heritage. Laguna runs deep.What makes Laguna Beach unforgettable lives far beyond the shoreline. It’s the full ecosystem: mazes of winding trails, canyon studios, an offbeat creative legacy, and a community passionately committed to keeping it all thriving.With seven miles of protected coastline, 22,000 acres of protected wilderness, and a legacy shaped by artists, activists, and outdoor enthusiasts, Laguna offers far more than any postcard could ever capture. It’s a living ethos that invites curiosity, rewards intention, and inspires each visitor to leave it better than they found it.Start Planning Your TripDownload the official Visit Laguna Beach Destination Guide now or request a complimentary copy by mail to start planning your vacation.EventsThere’s always something going on in Laguna Beach.
